title: Among EUR-paying customers in the LAM segment who were active in 2012, whic
question: Among EUR-paying customers in the LAM segment who were active in 2012, which country hosted the gas station where the highest total transaction price occurred?

prediction.sql:
SELECT T4."XCL_006"
FROM customers AS T1
INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1."XCL_001" = T2."XCL_019"
INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS T3 ON T1."XCL_001" = T3."XCL_013"
INNER JOIN gasstations AS T4 ON T3."XCL_015" = T4."XCL_004"
WHERE T1."XCL_002" = 'LAM'
  AND T1."XCL_003" = 'EUR'
  AND T2."XCL_020" LIKE '2012%'
GROUP BY T4."XCL_006"
ORDER BY SUM(T3."XCL_018") DESC
LIMIT 1
